description: Buyer side: what your principal has already learned buying services on Bitroad, so a fresh agent instance does not start from zero. Your principal's own history only, never another buyer's. Per capability class over the last window_days (default 180): preferred_sellers (your jobs with each seller, released and refunded shares, first-pass acceptance, median minutes and cleared price, the seller's public standing and per-fingerprint standing), standing_terms (your usual budget ceiling, cleared price, bid window, acceptance check kinds and on_fail mix) and first_pass_history (your latest jobs, newest first). Money is minor-unit strings. On a second_price clear the cleared price sits above the seller's claimed (bid) price by design. Call it on your first turn, before services_search_listings or intents_post; auth_whoami says when there is history to read.

capability_class.description: Optional exact capability class, e.g. code_review.security. With category, its first segment must equal it.

category.description: Optional service category, e.g. synthetic_data. Omit for every category.

currency.description: Optional currency. Figures never mix currencies.

limit.description: How many of your latest jobs first_pass_history returns, 1 to 50 (default 10).
